G1.rationale: Postgraduate or undergraduate degree delivering comprehensive education in Master of Educational and Developmental Psychology and Doctor of Philosophy.
evidenceLines: You will enrol for year one in the Master of Educational and Developmental Psychology. This requires completion of the initial 48 credit points of the combined degree consisting of eight advanced coursework units where you will commence preparation of your thesis research proposal. The first professional experience units are undertaken in the first year.

Upon satisfactory completion of the first 48 credit points, you will enrol in the research intensive component in the Master of Educational and Developmental Psychology and Doctor of Philosophy. In year two, you will complete the remaining two practicum units, further develop and present your research proposal, finalise ethical clearance and progress the research proposal towards confirmation that takes place in the last three months of the year. Enrolment for the final two years is dependent on  satisfying the confirmation process.
